hadith:
Ablutions (Wudu') - Narrated `Aisha:

(the mother of faithful believers) A child was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and it urinated on the garment of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for water and poured it over the soiled place.
message: When disbelievers rejected the truth brought by Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ), Allah reminded them that they had received no prior warning—yet the Prophet's mercy extended to all, even in simple acts of compassion. Just as Allah is As-Samee', the All-Hearer who listens to every sincere call, we should remember that our efforts to spread truth and show kindness are witnessed and valued by the Divine, regardless of how others respond. Let this inspire you to remain patient in your faith and compassionate in your actions, trusting that Allah hears and sees all that is genuine within your heart.
name:
As Samee' - السَّمِيعُ - The Hearer of all

The name As Samee' emphasizes Allah's attribute of complete awareness and understanding of all sounds and voices. This attribute assures believers that their prayers, thoughts, and cries for help are heard, providing comfort and hope. The origin of this name comes from the Arabic root 'سمع' (sama'), which means 'to hear'. This name reflects Allah's omnipresence and is often invoked in prayers and supplications.
verse:
Saba - Sheba - 34:43-44

When Our clear revelations are recited to them, they say, “This is only a man who wishes to hinder you from what your forefathers used to worship.” They also say, “This ˹Quran˺ is no more than a fabricated lie.” And the disbelievers say of the truth when it has come to them, “This is nothing but pure magic.”

˹They say so even though˺ We had never given them any scriptures to study, nor did We ever send them a warner before you ˹O Prophet˺.
